DampenerRule.description:
A fact that lowers a lead's score, never removes it (Levi's section 5, PLAN-V16 T1-5).

The first four are searched for on purpose; financial stress comes from the `healthy` fact.
The code is `scoring._dampeners`. How much each takes off is `score.dampeners` (T1-6).

- `recent_fitout`: a fitout or move in that city is strong within `strong_years` and moderate
  from there to `moderate_years`. A fitout longer ago than that doesn't count. It takes
  nothing off when the company's hiring would outgrow the space within `outgrow_months`
  (his "still list the lead"). A date that isn't known counts as moderate.
- `procurement`: `kinds` says which red flag is strong and which is moderate. A flag with no
  kind gets `strength`.
- `financial_stress`: `waived_by` are the signs that make it part of a consolidation that
  creates a move, when it takes nothing off (his "unless").

LeadFinderRunParams.description:
Every part with its default. The Start page shows these as the starting values.

A real run uses the model of its mode (above), which refuses the parts it doesn't use. So
send only the parts of your mode: `cities`, `area`, `triggers`, `since_days`, `sources`,
`target_companies`, `top_up` and `goal_leads` for discovery, `watchlist` for watchlist,
`companies`, `recheck` and `from_assistant` for company, and `caps` for every mode (testset has
nothing else).

area.description: Used by mode discovery only. Narrow a city to its CBD or inner suburbs. A city not listed uses all. Each key must be one of `cities`.
area.title: Area

caps.description: Used by every mode (discovery, watchlist, company, testset). Lower limits.

cities.description: Used by mode discovery only. Places to search, each once: any place in the rules (Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth, Sydney, Brisbane and the other cities and regional centres), or `["Australia"]` alone, which searches all of Australia at once: one search for each sign, and the research finds each company's city. The default is Melbourne.
cities.title: Cities

companies.description: Used by mode company only: 1 to 25 companies
companies.title: Companies

from_assistant.description: Used by mode company only. The Assistant started it, for one company (PLAN-V27 choice 19): it runs in the background, with at most 2 Claude requests at once.
from_assistant.title: From Assistant

goal_leads.description: Used by mode discovery only, and no longer used (PLAN-V20). It is still accepted so a page that was open before the change can start a run, and then ignored: no run stops for a goal of good leads. A run researches every company it chooses, up to its company limit and its money limits.
goal_leads.title: Goal Leads

recheck.description: Used by mode company only. Search again even when memory is fresh. Re-check sets it.
recheck.title: Recheck

since_days.description: Used by mode discovery only. Only events from the last 7, 14, 30, 90 or 180 days. The Start page offers 7, 30, 90 and 180 (6 months), with 90 first; 14 is for a schedule that runs every 2 weeks. Automatic runs look back 30.
since_days.title: Since Days

sources.description: Used by mode discovery only. Where discovery looks for companies: `web`, `property_daily` and `arealytics`, each once. Left out, every source that is ready (see `sources` in the run options). A tool that isn't ready is a 422 `source_not_ready`. Without `web`, the run makes no web searches for companies: they come from the tools' new items, free. The research of each company still uses every tool that is switched on (PLAN-V16 T1-8).
sources.title: Sources

target_companies.description: Used by mode discovery only (PLAN-V21 T1-4). How many companies the run tries to research, from 5 to the run's company limit. A run with fewer searches again in a new way (a sweep), while discovery's money lasts. It is not a goal of good leads and never ends a run early. Left out: `target_companies.default` in the run options.
target_companies.title: Target Companies

top_up.description: Used by mode discovery only, and no longer used (PLAN-V27 choice 5): a short run is not topped up from the HubSpot watchlist any more. It is still accepted so a saved run or schedule still loads.
top_up.title: Top Up

triggers.description: Used by mode discovery only. Trigger ids to look for, each once. The default is the main triggers.
triggers.title: Triggers

watchlist.description: Used by mode watchlist only. Which HubSpot companies to research.

Sweeps.description:
The wording of a discovery run's sweeps 2 to 4 (PLAN-V21 T1-3). Sweep 1 is each sign's own
searches (`discovery`). A sweep makes one request for each sign, and nothing one sweep finds
goes into another's request: a page can't steer another search.

- `sources` (sweep 2): searches for the signs no source group covers. A sign in a group uses
  that group's `discovery` searches, plus its own line here if it has one.
- `terms`: each sign in a few words, for `{terms}` in sweeps 3 and 4.
- `sector_groups` and `sectors` (sweep 3): each sign by sector group. Each template names the
  `{sector}`, and the request has one search for each group.
- `areas` (sweep 4): each sign by area, the CBD first, then the inner suburbs (`{area}`). For
  all of Australia, `{area}` is each priority city by name.

The backend won't start when a sign a run can search has no sweep 2 wording or no `terms`, or
when the sector groups don't hold each of Levi's priority sectors once

post.description:
Signs in with an email or a username and a password, and sets the session cookie.

The answer is the same, and takes as long, whether the login is unknown, the account is
switched off or the password is wrong, so nobody can learn which accounts exist. A new token
is made at every sign-in. This is the one route that needs no session.

**Guessing is limited.** The first 2 wrong tries in a row cost nothing. Each one after that
makes the next wait longer (2 seconds, doubling, up to a minute), and the 10th locks the login
for 15 minutes. A login that matches no account is slowed and locked the same way, so the lock
never says which accounts exist. One IP address may make 20 wrong tries in 15 minutes. A try
made during a wait is answered 429 and isn't checked. A right password ends the count.

Set-Cookie.description: The session cookie: `contour_session` over http, or `__Host-contour_session` over HTTPS. HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and Secure over HTTPS. It lives until the browser closes, or for the length of the session with `keep_signed_in`.
